items.item_text: Bachelor's degree is preferred in a related field plus two years' experience providing administrative support, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Demonstrated knowledge of and experience using UCD/UCDHS payroll and personnel databases (i.e.UC Path, AggieService, Cognos, PeopleSoft, etc.
Exercise authority to direct and motivate others.
Planning, problem-solving and critical thinking skills to anticipate avert or resolve issues of staffing, scheduling and task allocation.

Knowledge of personal mainframe computers, software tools, including but not limited to: word processing, spreadsheet, database development, and maintenance, Window, Excel, PowerPoint, Microsoft Outlook and other application packages specific to the health career environment.

Comprehensive knowledge of University academic personnel policies and procedures and ability to interpret them in a clear and logical manner. Knowledge of academic salary and benefits administration, including understanding of faculty payment processes to provide information, calculate leaves and problem-solve all areas including payroll.
